verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs explicitly list FP8, INT4, GPTQ/AWQ quantization support, along with MXFP4, NVFP4, INT8, GGUF and compressed-tensors. A dedicated quantization docs page covers per-scheme backend overrides and custom quantization methods. A community comment credits its low-precision model library. The one community complaint about missing 4-bit support is from an early (2023) thread and is superseded by the current documented INT4/GPTQ/AWQ support, so it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of loading specific FP8/GPTQ/AWQ checkpoints.
